content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps that undermine a reliable merits decision. The agency's own fact-finding report found S1 falsely accused Complainant of assault and that staff feared S1 retaliating, and a Nurse Manager said S1's differential treatment of a comparator light-duty nurse was unexplained and 'suspicious and unjustified.' The final decision does not address this evidence, nor the comparator, when accepting S1's stated reasons. S1's own account and the comparator's circumstances are not described. The AWOL analysis ignores the Employee Health release slip. Claim 4 (the medical retirement remark) gets no analysis. The reprisal finding rests on a narrow view of protected activity that overlooks the retaliation accusation made at the February 14 grievance meeting, and the decision does not weigh the hostile-environment evidence. Pretext is not tested against the contrary evidence."}
